supplementary_family_rules: S1 exists only if M3I-2 later passes the Data Gate.
S2 exists only if financing later receives a prospective exact lock and passes its Gate.
If only S1 exists, supplementary_family_size = 1 and the Holm adjustment is mathematically unnecessary, but the family identity remains recorded.
If S1 and S2 exist, Holm is applied across exactly S1 and S2.
All results must be labelled supplementary/robustness.
No confirmatory superiority claim is permitted.
